rules: Score the MEANING against the expected reading (1 = the idea is there; 0.5 = part of it; 0 = only shapes/colours/labels or a different idea). Advice flags: advice_stated = the reader says the ANIMATION itself (picture or on-screen text) states or implies a financial action: buy, keep renting, buy now / before something, wait, hold N years, invest, pick a month. advice_inferred = the reader drew that action themself (answer 5 says own conclusion or none). caution_only = general care only (check your own numbers, ask an adviser). Quote the reader verbatim for any flag. Also return "q5": "video" | "own" | "none".
scale: score: 1 = đủ phần ĐÚNG NGHĨA; 0.5 = một phần nghĩa; 0 = chỉ tả hình hoặc nghĩa khác. advice_stated: true khi câu trả lời cho thấy CHÍNH VIDEO (hình, chữ trên hình, lời) nêu hay ngụ ý một hành động tài chính (mua, bán, giữ, chờ, khoá, chọn/tránh một sản phẩm), kể cả phán "X an toàn/tốt hơn" mà người đọc gán cho video. advice_inferred: true khi người đọc TỰ SUY hành động đó từ dữ liệu (câu 4/5: "my own conclusion", "the video doesn't say …"). caution_only: true khi chỉ có thận trọng chung (tự kiểm số của mình, hỏi chuyên gia/bên cho vay/công ty bảo hiểm, hỏi báo giá) — không tính là khuyên. quote: trích nguyên văn câu của người đọc làm căn cứ cho cờ (rỗng nếu không cờ nào).

1. The animation shows a grid of tiles. Each tile is a month between January 1991 and July 2016 when someone could have started buying instead of renting. A lit tile means the buyer was ahead after ten years. A dark tile means the renter was ahead. The headline says the buyer came out ahead in about 3 in 4 starting months (75.6%). The renter was ahead in 75 of 307 months. The on-screen text says the buy-versus-rent comparison counted interest, tax, insurance, repairs, and buying and selling costs.

2. Very little changes in the grid. The dark band stays in the middle of the timeline, and the lit tiles stay on either side. What changes is the labels. The "renter ahead: 75 of 307" label appears in frame 3. The "counted: interest · tax · insurance · repairs · buying and selling" line replaces the date axis in frames 5 and 6. A small block at the right edge is also visible throughout.

3. In the historical US data (home prices, rents, and mortgage rates), buying beat renting over a ten-year hold in most starting months, even after the main costs of owning. The cases where renting won were concentrated in one stretch of start dates in the middle of the period. The animation labels the picture "illustrative" and says "US only · history, not a forecast."

4. A viewer might conclude that buying has usually paid off over ten-year periods in the past, even after counting all the ownership costs. The animation makes this point only loosely and doesn't tell the viewer what to do. It also warns that this is history and not a forecast. The result depends on when you buy and how long you stay, and it covers only the US.

5. The animation suggested the conclusion about the past. The headline "buyer ahead: about 3 in 4" and the "counted" line say it directly. It never told the viewer to buy or to rent. The idea that you might act on this is my own inference. The animation's "not a forecast" label points the other way.
